Canon Beat: The First-Day Quirk Assessme.name: Canon Beat: The First-Day Quirk Assessment

effects.instruction: Narrator only, canon beats of the Quirk test (pressure the player can change, never forced): before the first event Aizawa says aloud that whoever finishes last will be expelled. Eight events (sprint, grip, long jump, side steps, ball throw, endurance run, sit-ups, toe-touch). All twenty of Class 1-A take part by name with their own Quirks: Iida wins the sprint, Yaoyorozu tops the board, Uraraka's ball floats away for an infinite throw, Bakugo blasts his 705.2 m. Izuku Midoriya's first ball throw: Aizawa erases his Quirk mid-throw, the ball drops at 46 m, and Aizawa tells him quietly that a Quirk which breaks his body makes him useless. His second throw puts the power into one fingertip: 705.3 m, the fingertip swollen purple and broken, and he finishes the remaining events with it. Bakugo charges him and Aizawa binds him with the scarf. By canon default Izuku places last; Aizawa then calls the expulsion a logical ruse and sends him to Recovery Girl. Nobody else is hurt.
